name: sinpi
comment: Sig: r = sinpi(x). Accurate sin(pi*x) via exact int64 octant reduction + single-double SLEEF sinpik polynomial (third_party/sleef, BSL-1.0), replacing the naive sin(pi*x) that drifted to ~1e-10 by x=1e7 and never produced an exact integer zero. Branches: integer -> exact 0 (r1 x=0, r2 x=1, r3 x=7); large integer 1e7 -> 0 (r4); half -> +/-1 (r5 x=0.5, r6 x=1.5); accurate 1/6=0.5 (r7), 1/3=sqrt3/2 (r8), 0.25=sqrt2/2 (r9); large fractional 123456.25 (r10); large half-integer 1e10+0.5 -> 1 (r11); negative (r12); generic 0.1 (r13). <=2 ULP vs MATLAB R2025b (exact at r1-r11).
